title: Animal Crossing
description: Animal Crossing, known in Japan as Dōbutsu no Mori, is a social simulation game developed and published by Nintendo. It was first released in 2001 for the Nintendo 64 in Japan, followed by an enhanced port for the GameCube. The GameCube version was localized for North America, Australia, and Europe between 2002 and 2004. It is the first game in the Animal Crossing series.
notes: Unofficial Windows, Linux, macOS, Android and iOS port of Animal Crossing for GameCube; bring your own disc image.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
description: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker is a 2002 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the GameCube. An installment in The Legend of Zelda series, it was released in Japan on December 13, 2002, in North America on March 23, 2003, and in Europe on May 2, 2003.
notes: Wind Waker HD running natively on Android through static recompilation and Vulkan; bring your own game files.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
description: Halo: Combat Evolved is a 2001 first-person shooter game developed by Bungie and published by Microsoft Game Studios. The game was released on November 15, 2001 for the Xbox, with ports to Microsoft Windows and Mac OS X released in 2003. It is the first installment in the Halo franchise. Set in the 26th century, players assume the role of Master Chief, a cybernetically enhanced supersoldier. Accompanied by an artificial intelligence construct named Cortana and the human forces of the United Nations Space Command, players battle against an alien theocracy known as the Covenant while they attempt to uncover the secrets of the eponymous Halo, a ring-shaped artificial world.
notes: Halo CE ported for Windows, macOS, Linux, Steam Deck, FreeBSD and Android; requires your own game data.

title: Unreal
description: Unreal is a 1998 first-person shooter game developed by Epic MegaGames and Digital Extremes and published by GT Interactive for Microsoft Windows. Set in a science-fiction universe, the player controls a prisoner whose prison spacecraft crash-lands on a mysterious planet, where they must find a way to escape while combatting the occupying alien empire. It is the first entry in the Unreal game series and was powered by the titular Unreal Engine. The game reached sales of 1.5 million units by 2002.
notes: Port of the 1998 shooter Unreal (v200) for Android 8 and newer, 32-bit and 64-bit builds; requires your own game files.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass
description: The Legend of Zelda is a video game series created by Japanese game designers Shigeru Miyamoto and Takashi Tezuka. It is primarily developed and published by Nintendo, but some installments and re-releases have been outsourced to Flagship, Grezzo, and Tantalus Media.
notes: Native PC and Android port of Phantom Hourglass by static recompilation; bring your own ROM.

title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
notes: Unofficial Android arm64 port of the Jak and Daxter trilogy powered by OpenGOAL; bring your own game files.

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
description: Super Mario Bros. Wonder is a 2023 platform game by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch. It is the first side-scrolling Super Mario platform game since New Super Mario Bros. U (2012). The player controls one of several Mario characters as they attempt to stop Bowser, who plots to take over a new land known as the Flower Kingdom after using the magical Wonder Flower to fuse himself with the kingdom's castle.
notes: Static recompilation of Super Mario Bros. Wonder with Vulkan rendering for macOS, Android and desktop; bring your own game files.

title: Prototype
notes: Current native ARM64 Android port of Prototype (2009), replacing the discontinued ProtoRe listing. Requires your legally obtained PC game files; the APK does not contain them.

title: Grand Theft Auto IV
notes: Android ARM64 static recompilation of the Xbox 360 game. The maintainer says the project is on hiatus; Adreno is the tested target and Mali support is experimental. Bring your own game dump.

title: Pikmin
notes: Native Android port with touch and controller support. Most of the game is playable; bring your own supported GameCube disc image.

title: Pikmin 2
notes: Playable from start to finish on the project's documented USA and European discs. Bring your own supported GameCube disc image.

title: Open Nectar
description: A native launcher for Pikmin and Pikmin 2. One Android APK supports both games; install your own GameCube disc image in the launcher. Pikmin 2 is documented as playable from start to finish, with touch and controller support.

title: 0 A.D.
description: 0 A.D. is a real-time strategy video game under development by Wildfire Games. It is a historical war and economy game focusing on the years between 500 BC and 1 BC, with the years between 1 AD and 500 AD planned to be developed in the future. The game is cross-platform, playable on Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, and OpenBSD. It is free and open-source, composed entirely of free software and free media, using the GNU GPLv2 license for the game engine source code, and the CC BY-SA license for the game art and music.
notes: 0 A.D. (Wildfire Games, 2010) for Android (source port). Latest release: v0.28.0-android-1. It ships the game files with the port, so it does not build from your own copy. This Android port distributes the game's own files, so it is not built from a copy you own. Its legal situation differs from the rest of the catalog and it may be removed.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
description: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask is a 2000 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. It is the second game in The Legend of Zelda series to use 3D graphics, following Ocarina of Time (1998). Designed by a creative team led by Eiji Aonuma, Yoshiaki Koizumi, and Shigeru Miyamoto, Majora's Mask was completed in less than two years. It features enhanced graphics and several gameplay changes, but reuses elements and character models from Ocarina of Time, a creative decision made necessary by time constraints.
notes: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (Nintendo, 2000) for Android (source port). Latest release: v1.1.2P1. Needs your own copy of the game (Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask (USA).z64).

siblingPorts.notes: Android port of Zelda64 Recompiled, the Majora's Mask (Nintendo 64, 2000) recompilation. Bring your own ROM. Latest release: 0.6.10.

title: Abuse
description: Abuse is a run and gun video game developed by Crack dot Com and published by Electronic Arts in North America and Origin Systems in Europe. It was released on February 29, 1996 for MS-DOS. A Mac OS port of the game was published by Bungie and released on March 5, 1997. The game's source code, along with some of the shareware content, has been in the public domain since the late 1990s and has been ported to Linux and many other platforms.
notes: Native Android port of the 1996 dark sci-fi platformer Abuse by Crack dot Com, built on top of apancik/Abuse_2025. Latest release: v1.1.

title: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere
description: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere is a 1999 combat flight simulation game by Namco for the PlayStation. The third game in the Ace Combat franchise, it was released in Japan on May 27, 1999, and internationally the following year. Players fly fighter aircraft and must complete a variety of mission objectives, such as destroying squadrons of enemy planes or protecting a base from an invading unit.
notes: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere (Namco, 1999) for Android (decompilation). Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Glider PRO
description: Glider is an action game written by John Calhoun for the Mac and published as shareware in 1988 under the company name Soft Dorothy Software. The object of the game is to fly a paper plane through the rooms of a house. Air currents from heat ducts and fans affect the plane's movement, while assorted household objects are usually deadly. Some rooms have special mechanics, such as the ability to slide along grease-covered surfaces. Each room is presented as a two-dimensional side view.
notes: Multiplatform port of Glider PRO, the classic Macintosh paper airplane game, with an Android build and the original house layouts.

title: AeroGauge
description: AeroGauge is a 1997 racing game developed by Locomotive and published by ASCII Entertainment for the Nintendo 64. It is conceptually similar to Psygnosis's Wipeout and Acclaim Entertainment's Extreme-G; the main difference is that the vehicles in the game fly instead of hovering. AeroGauge garnered mediocre reviews, with criticism directed at its routine concept, excessive pop up, lack of weapons and power-ups, and overly high difficulty.
notes: Static recompilation of AeroGauge (N64) with N64Recomp and the RT64 renderer. It requires your own game files.

title: Alabaster Dawn
description: Alabaster Dawn is a role-playing game published by Radical Fish Games in 2026.
notes: Unofficial Android WebView port of Alabaster Dawn (Radical Fish Games) plus a desktop controller fix. No game files included: you need your own copy. Latest release: v0.9.0.

title: Another Metroid 2 Remake
description: Metroid is an action-adventure game franchise created by Nintendo. The player controls the bounty hunter Samus Aran, who protects the galaxy from Space Pirates and their attempts to harness the power of the parasitic Metroid creatures. Metroid combines the platforming of Super Mario Bros. and the exploration of The Legend of Zelda with a science fiction setting and an emphasis on nonlinear gameplay. Metroid games are mostly presented as either side-scrolling or from a first-person perspective.
notes: Android tool that patches the fan remake AM2R 1.1 into a modern Android build. It works with your own copy of the AM2R files.

title: NetHack
description: NetHack is a free and open-source, single-player roguelike video game developed by the NetHack Development Team, a group of developers who collaborate over the internet. It was first released on 28 July 1987 as a fork of Hack, and it is one of the oldest video games still in active development. In the game, the player creates a character, then descends through the Mazes of Menace, a multi-level dungeon, fighting monsters and collecting treasure, with the goal of retrieving the Amulet of Yendor and escaping with it. NetHack has been cited as an influence on later games, including Diablo.
notes: Android port of NetHack, the classic open-source roguelike. It is a standalone build that does not need the original game.

siblingPorts.title: Amphitere (NetHack)
siblingPorts.notes: Android port of NetHack focused on dual-screen devices. It is a standalone build that does not need the original game.

title: Doom RPG
description: Doom RPG is a 2005 role-playing video game developed by Fountainhead Entertainment and published by JAMDAT Mobile for mobile phones. It combines the Doom first-person shooter franchise with role-playing elements. The storyline incorporates many similar events of Doom 3, but involves different characters than those in the third game.
notes: Doom RPG: engine remake by andreyvelsk for Android, Windows. Bring your own copy of the game.

title: Animal Crossing
description: Animal Crossing, known in Japan as Dōbutsu no Mori, is a social simulation game developed and published by Nintendo. It was first released in 2001 for the Nintendo 64 in Japan, followed by an enhanced port for the GameCube. The GameCube version was localized for North America, Australia, and Europe between 2002 and 2004. It is the first game in the Animal Crossing series.
notes: Android port of the Animal Crossing (GameCube) PC port. The README states it was built with Z.ai, OpenAI Codex and Claude. Bring your own disc. Latest release: v0.5.0.

title: Apotris
description: Apotris is a puzzle game published by Independent for Game Boy Advance, released in 2022.
notes: Unofficial native Android port of Apotris, built from the arm64 Linux version, with touch controls and the original block-stacking rules.

title: Caesar III
description: Caesar III is a city-building game released on September 30, 1998, for Microsoft Windows and Mac OS, developed by Impressions Games and published by Sierra On-Line. It is the third installment of the Caesar series of games and is part of Sierra's City Building series. Players assume the role of a provincial governor to build thriving cities across the Roman Empire, in which they must ensure their citizens have their needs met, and deal with various disasters, angry gods and hostile enemies.
notes: Open-source re-implementation of Caesar III that runs with the original game files. On top of the stable releases, the project publishes continuous (weekly) builds.

siblingPorts.title: Julius
siblingPorts.notes: Faithful reimplementation of Caesar III that fixes bugs and runs on modern systems; Augustus adds gameplay changes.

siblingPorts.notes: Caesar III (Sierra On-Line, 1998) for Android (source port). Latest release: v4.0.0. Needs your own copy of the game (Game Files).

title: Automobili Lamborghini
description: Automobili Lamborghini is a 1997 racing video game developed and published by Titus France for the Nintendo 64. It is a successor to Lamborghini American Challenge.
notes: Static recompilation of Automobili Lamborghini (N64) with N64Recomp and the RT64 renderer. It requires a copy of the game.

title: Banjo-Kazooie
description: Banjo-Kazooie is a 1998 platform game developed by Rare and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. Controlling the player characters, the bear Banjo and the bird Kazooie, the player attempts to save Banjo's kidnapped sister Tooty from the witch Gruntilda. The player explores nine nonlinear worlds to gather items and progress. Using Banjo and Kazooie's traversal and combat abilities, they complete challenges such as solving puzzles, jumping over obstacles, and defeating bosses.

siblingPorts.title: Banjo-Kazooie (Android, 8cee)
siblingPorts.notes: Banjo-Kazooie (Nintendo, 1998) running on Android through static recompilation. You need your own copy of the game.

title: BanjoRecomp Android
description: BanjoRecomp Android is a action-adventure game for Nintendo 64, released in 2000.
notes: Android Port of Banjo-Kazooie made using N64: Recompiled.

title: Barony
description: Barony is a role-playing game in 2015.
notes: Android fork of the Barony source, published with the developer's permission. The APK contains engine code only and needs an owned Barony v5.0.2 installation for its data.

title: Super Smash Bros.
description: Super Smash Bros. is a series of platform fighting video games published by Nintendo. Created by Masahiro Sakurai, the Super Smash Bros. series is a crossover featuring many characters from other video game series created by Nintendo and other developers. Its gameplay is distinct from traditional fighting games, with players aiming to knock each other off stages after accumulating damage with numerous attacks. The games have also featured a variety of side modes, including single-player story modes.
notes: PC port of Super Smash Bros. (N64) for the USA and Japanese releases, built on the ssb-decomp-re decompilation with libultraship. It runs on Windows, Linux, macOS and Android, and adds widescreen, texture packs, C mods and competitive options.

title: BattleTanx: Global Assault
description: BattleTanx: Global Assault is an action game developed and published by The 3DO Company for the Nintendo 64 and PlayStation, in which players control futuristic tanks in a post-apocalyptic scenario. It is a sequel to the Nintendo 64 game BattleTanx, which utilized the same method of game play. Although it earned relatively positive reviews from critics, 3DO went bankrupt before another sequel could be released.
notes: Native recompilation of BattleTanx: Global Assault (Nintendo 64) with N64Recomp and RT64, in super-beta state for Windows and Linux. An Android build is planned. It needs the player's own legally obtained game dump.

title: BLACK
description: Black is a 2006 first-person shooter game developed by Criterion Games and published by Electronic Arts (EA) for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox. The player assumes control of Jack Kellar, a US Army special forces soldier being interrogated about his previous missions involving a terrorist operation. Gameplay involves players fighting terrorists by using firearms and grenades. The game is notable and was heavily promoted for its large focus on destructive effects and explosions during gameplay, as well as its cinema-inspired action and sound quality.
notes: Native Android port of BLACK (Xbox) with touch controls, gyroscope aiming, controller support and extended graphics options. Bring your own disc image.

title: Bloodborne
description: Bloodborne is a 2015 action role-playing game developed by FromSoftware and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 4. The game follows a Hunter through the decrepit Gothic, Victorian-era inspired city of Yharnam, whose inhabitants are afflicted with a blood-borne disease. Attempting to find the source of the plague, the player's character unravels the city's mysteries while fighting beasts and eldritch beings.
notes: Experimental Android port of Bloodborne (PS4, CUSA03173 v1.09) for Snapdragon devices, built on the bbport project. The runtime and renderer run natively on ARM64 while the game's original x86-64 code is translated at runtime with FEXCore. It boots, loads saves and renders properly, but is still an alpha. Requires your own decrypted copy of Bloodborne updated to v1.09.

title: Blue Dragon
description: Blue Dragon is a role-playing video game developed by Mistwalker and Artoon in collaboration with Microsoft Game Studios Japan and published by Microsoft Game Studios for the Xbox 360. It is based on a design by Final Fantasy series creator Hironobu Sakaguchi, who also supervised development and wrote the plot. It is both Mistwalker's debut title and the first title to be helmed by Sakaguchi outside of Square Enix.
notes: Android recompilation of Blue Dragon (Xbox 360), separate from the desktop reblue project. It is an early build that needs your own game files.

siblingPorts.notes: Blue Dragon (Android): native recompilation of Blue Dragon for android. Bring your own copy of the game.

notes: BlueWake: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker (GameCube, 2002) recompiled natively for macOS, iOS, Windows, Linux and Android. Bring your own game disc. Latest release: v0.8.0.

Set in the 26th century, players assume the role of Master Chief, a cybernetically enhanced supersoldier.

title: Broforce
description: Broforce is a 2015 side-scrolling run and gun game developed by Free Lives and published by Devolver Digital. The game has the player as one of several "bros", based on popular culture action movie icons, rescuing other "bros" through highly destructible environments.
notes: Unofficial Android port of Broforce designed for gamepads. It ships no game files and needs your own Steam copy.

notes: Android port of the Brogue roguelike, with touch controls and the original dungeon crawl.

title: Buckshot Roulette
description: Buckshot Roulette is a 2023 indie tabletop horror video game developed and published by Estonian video game developer Mike Klubnika on itch.io. It was released on Steam by Critical Reflex on 4 April 2024 to coincide with a new update. The game has been likened to the 2021 roguelike video game Inscryption, despite contrasting visual styles. Klubnika developed the game in the Godot game engine and also composed the game's soundtrack.
notes: Mobile port of Buckshot Roulette for Android and iOS. It needs your own game data and is a community project.

title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds
game: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds
description: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds is a 2003 beat 'em up video game developed by Eurocom and published by Vivendi Universal Games for GameCube, PlayStation 2 and Xbox. It is the fourth game in the Buffy the Vampire Slayer franchise and the only multiplatform game. It was the first to allow players to control characters other than Buffy Summers and feature a fully developed multiplayer mode.
project: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds (Android)
notes: Native port of Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds (Xbox) for Windows and Android. Bring your own disc.

title: Call of Duty
description: Call of Duty (CoD) is a first-person shooter video game series and media franchise published by Activision, starting in 2003. The games were first developed by Infinity Ward, then by Treyarch, Sledgehammer Games and Raven Software. Several spin-off and handheld games were made by other developers. The most recent game, Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, was released on November 14, 2025. The next game, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, is scheduled for release on October 23, 2026.
notes: Experimental static recompilation of classic Call of Duty 1.5 for Android. Bring your own original PC game files.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2
description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 is a 2009 first-person shooter game developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision. It is the sixth installment in the Call of Duty series and the direct sequel to Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare. It was released worldwide on November 10, 2009, for Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360. A separate version for the Nintendo DS, titled Modern Warfare: Mobilized, was also released on the same day. A version for OS X was developed by Aspyr and released in May 2014, and the Xbox 360 version was made backward compatible for the Xbox One in 2018.
notes: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009, Xbox 360) recompiled ahead-of-time into native code for Android (ARM64), Linux and Windows (x86-64), with Vulkan rendering, touchscreen and controller input. Not an emulator; it requires user-supplied game files. Experimental. Latest release: v0.1.0-alpha.13 (APK).

title: Carmageddon 2: Carpocalypse Now
description: The world's first high-speed internal organ liberation simulator is back in full 3D! The slaughter is bloodier, the body parts fly further, and the destruction is heavier. Crash and burn through the 3D rendered crowds with the pedal to the metal.
notes: Decompilation and native port of Carmageddon 2, with a Linux AppImage and armv7 Android APKs. Bring your own original game data.

title: Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness
description: Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness is a 1999 action-adventure game developed and published by Konami for the Nintendo 64. A prequel and expanded version of Castlevania , also released earlier in the year on the same platform, it contains a revision of the original game with improved graphics, added villains, and alternate versions of some levels.
notes: Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness (Nintendo 64, 1999) recompiled into a native executable with N64Recomp, with Windows and Android builds. Bring your own ROM. Latest release: v0.2.31.

title: Castlevania
description: Castlevania, also informally referred to as Castlevania 64, is a 1999 action-adventure game developed and published by Konami for the Nintendo 64. An expanded version of the game, Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness, was released later in the same year.
notes: Android reimplementation of the original Castlevania, distributed as an open-source build. It uses the game's original assets from your own copy.

title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
description: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night is a 1997 action role-playing game developed and published by Konami for the PlayStation and Sega Saturn. It is a direct sequel to Castlevania: Rondo of Blood, set five years after its events. It was directed and produced by Toru Hagihara, with Koji Igarashi acting as assistant director.
notes: Recompilation project for Castlevania: Symphony of the Night (PS1, 1997) with Windows and Android builds. Bring your own disc. Latest release: android-v0.10.1b.

title: Conker's Bad Fur Day
description: Conker's Bad Fur Day is a 2001 platform game developed by Rare for the Nintendo 64. It is the second installment in the Conker series, after Conker's Pocket Tales (1999). The game follows Conker, a greedy, hard-drinking red squirrel who must return home to his girlfriend, Berri, after an evening of heavily drinking at the local pub. Most of the game requires the player to complete a linear sequence of challenges that involve jumping over obstacles, solving puzzles, and fighting enemies. In the multiplayer mode, up to four players can compete against each other in seven different game types.
notes: Conker's Bad Fur Day (Rare, 2001) for Android (static recompilation). Latest release: android-v0.2.15. Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Celeste
description: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain, in this super-tight platformer from the creators of TowerFall. Brave hundreds of hand-crafted challenges, uncover devious secrets, and piece together the mystery of the mountain.
notes: Native Android port of Celeste that runs your own PC copy, built with .NET, FNA and SDL3 and rendered with Vulkan. It includes a launcher to import the game.

title: Knuckles' Chaotix
description: Knuckles' Chaotix is a 1995 platform game developed and published by Sega for the 32X. A spin-off of the Sonic the Hedgehog series, it features Knuckles the Echidna and four other characters known as the Chaotix, who must prevent Doctor Robotnik and Metal Sonic from obtaining six magic rings and conquering a mysterious island. The gameplay is similar to previous Sonic games: players complete levels while collecting rings and defeating enemies.
notes: Static recompilation of Knuckles' Chaotix (Sega 32X) to native C++, with true widescreen. It builds for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android and requires your own ROM.

title: Chex Quest
description: Chex Quest is a non-violent first-person shooter video game released in 1997 by Digital Café. It was originally intended as a Chex cereal promotion aimed at children aged 6–9 and up. It is a total conversion of the more explicitly violent video game Doom. Chex Quest won both a Golden EFFIE Award for Advertising Effectiveness and Golden Reggie Award for Promotional Achievement in 1998. It is known for being the first ever video game to be included as a cereal box prize.
notes: Chex Quest (Digital Café, 1996) for Android (source port). Latest release: 3.5.0. Needs your own copy of the game (CHEX.WAD).

title: Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour
description: Command and Conquer: Generals – Zero Hour is the expansion pack for the 2003 video game Command & Conquer: Generals. Zero Hour added several new abilities and units to each side, and a new mode of play called Generals' Challenge, along with a lot more changes, new features and bug/glitch fixes.
notes: Android arm64 port of Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour built on GeneralsX, SDL3 and DXVK, with touch controls. Bring your own retail game files.

siblingPorts.notes: Command & Conquer: Generals: Zero Hour (Electronic Arts, 2003) for Android (source port). Latest release: v1.4.0. Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert
description: Command & Conquer: Red Alert is a real-time strategy video game in the Command & Conquer franchise, developed and published by Westwood Studios in 1996. The second game to bear the Command & Conquer title, Red Alert is the prequel to the original Command & Conquer of 1995, and takes place in the alternate early history of Command & Conquer when Allied Forces battle an aggressive Soviet Union for control over the European mainland.
notes: Unofficial native port of Command & Conquer: Red Alert for Android, iOS, Linux and macOS with SDL2 video, audio and input. No game assets included.

title: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Dawn
description: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Dawn is a strategy game published by Electronic Arts for Windows, released in 1995.
notes: Unofficial native port of Command & Conquer: Tiberian Dawn for Android, iOS and macOS. Bring your own game assets.

title: Colin McRae Rally 2.0
description: Colin McRae Rally 2.0 is a racing video game developed and published by Codemasters for PlayStation, Microsoft Windows and Game Boy Advance.
notes: Native SDL3 port of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 built from the CMR2Decomp decompilation, with Android and Windows builds. No game data included.

title: Theme Hospital
description: Theme Hospital is a business simulation game developed by Bullfrog Productions and published by Electronic Arts in 1997 for MS-DOS and Microsoft Windows compatible PCs in which players design and operate a privately owned hospital with the goal of curing patients of fictitious comical ailments. The game is the thematic successor to Theme Park, also produced by Bullfrog, and the second installment in their Theme series, and part of their Designer Series. The game is noted for its humour, and contains numerous references to pop culture.
notes: Theme Hospital (Electronic Arts, 1997) for Android (source port). Needs your own copy of the game (HOSP folder).

title: Crash Bandicoot
description: Crash Bandicoot is a video game franchise created by Naughty Dog as a flagship title for Sony's PlayStation console. The series began with the development of the first game in 1994, inspired by the emerging capabilities of 3D consoles and games like Donkey Kong Country (1994). The protagonist, initially conceived as "Willy the Wombat", evolved into Crash Bandicoot, a goofy, genetically mutated eastern barred bandicoot who escapes the clutches of the mad scientist Doctor Neo Cortex.
notes: Native PC port of Crash Bandicoot (PS1) produced via the RecompOne static recompilation stack, distributed as versioned releases. Requires your own PS1 disc dump. The project is not affiliated with the original developer.

title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
description: Crash Team Racing is a 1999 kart racing game developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation. It is the fourth installment in the Crash Bandicoot series and the final Crash Bandicoot game to be developed by Naughty Dog. The game's story focuses on the efforts of Crash Bandicoot, Doctor Neo Cortex, and other ragtag team of characters in the Crash Bandicoot series, who must race against the egomaniacal Nitros Oxide to save the Earth from destruction.
notes: CTR: Crash Team Racing (Sony Computer Entertainment, 1999) for Android (source port). Latest release: v0.1.0. Needs your own copy of the game (CTR - Crash Team Racing (USA)).

title: Counter-Strike
description: Counter-Strike (CS) is a series of multiplayer tactical first-person shooter video games, in which opposing teams attempt to complete various objectives. The series began on Windows in 1999 with the release of the first game, Counter-Strike. It was initially released as a mod for Half-Life that was designed by Minh Le and Jess Cliffe before the rights to the mod's intellectual property were acquired by Valve, the developers of Half-Life, who then turned Counter-Strike into a retail product released in 2000.
notes: Reverse-engineered client for Counter-Strike 1.6 aimed at mobile and other unsupported platforms. It runs the original game data and ships builds for Android, Windows and Linux.

title: Crash Team Racing
description: Crash Team Racing is a 1999 kart racing game developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation. It is the fourth installment in the Crash Bandicoot series and the final Crash Bandicoot game to be developed by Naughty Dog. The game's story focuses on the efforts of Crash Bandicoot, Doctor Neo Cortex, and other ragtag team of characters in the Crash Bandicoot series, who must race against the egomaniacal Nitros Oxide to save the Earth from destruction.
notes: Android port of the Crash Team Racing decompilation project (PS1, 1999). Bring your own disc. Latest release: Android-Build4.

title: The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall
description: The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall is a 1996 action role-playing game published by Bethesda Softworks. The second installment in the Elder Scrolls series, it was released on September 20, 1996 for MS-DOS, following the success of 1994's The Elder Scrolls: Arena. The story follows the player, sent by the Emperor, to free the ghost of King Lysandus from his earthly shackles and discover what happened to a letter sent from the Emperor to the former queen of Daggerfall.
notes: The Elder Scrolls II: DaggerFall (Bethesda Softworks, 1996) for Android (source port). Latest release: v1.1.1.9. Needs your own copy of the game (DaggerfallGameFiles.zip).

title: Dante's Inferno
description: Dante's Inferno is a 2010 action-adventure game developed by Visceral Games and published by Electronic Arts. The game was released for PlayStation 3, Xbox 360 and PlayStation Portable in February 2010. The PlayStation Portable version was developed by Artificial Mind and Movement.
notes: Community Android build of Dante's Inferno, separate from the desktop recompilation. It is an experimental project and some of its cases are untested. The original repository was taken down and the link no longer resolves.

title: Daytona USA
description: Daytona USA is a 1994 racing game developed by Sega AM2 and published by Sega for arcades. Inspired by the popularity of the NASCAR motor racing series in the United States, it has players race stock cars on one of three courses. It was the first game released on the Sega Model 2 arcade system board.
notes: Daytona USA (Sega, 1994) running on Nintendo 3DS and Windows and Android through source port. You need your own copy of the game.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit
description: Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit is a fighting video game for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 based on the anime Dragon Ball Z. The game was developed by Dimps and published in North America and Australia by Atari, and in Japan and Europe by Namco Bandai under the Bandai label. It was released in Japan on June 5, 2008, in Europe on June 6, 2008, North America on June 10, 2008, and in Australia on July 3, 2008.
notes: Native Android recompilation of Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit with ReXGlue. Bring your own copy of the Xbox 360 game.

siblingPorts.title: DBZ Burst Limit Android
siblingPorts.notes: Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit (Bandai Namco, 2008) for Android (source port). Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Dead or Alive: Xtreme Beach Volleyball
game: Dead or Alive: Xtreme Beach Volleyball
description: Dead or Alive Xtreme Beach Volleyball is a 2003 beach volleyball video game developed by Team Ninja and published by Tecmo for the Xbox. It is a spin-off of the Dead or Alive series which otherwise consisted of fighting games. It also marked the first game in the series to have a Mature rating from the Entertainment Software Rating Board due to partial nudity.
project: Dead or Alive Xtreme Beach Volleyball · Android
notes: Dead or Alive: Xtreme Beach Volleyball (Tecmo, 2003) for Android (source port). Latest release: v0.4.2-ru-USA6-Beach. Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Forza Horizon
description: Forza Horizon is a 2012 racing video game developed by Playground Games and published by Microsoft Studios for the Xbox 360 on 23 October 2012. The game is the fifth instalment of the Forza series, having originally spun-off from Turn 10 Studios-developed Forza Motorsport titles. Taking place during the fictitious Horizon Festival, a street racing event, the player's aim is to progress via winning races, while also increasing their popularity level by performing stunts and activities.

siblingPorts.notes: Forza Horizon: static recompilation by deivid22srk for Android, Windows. Bring your own copy of the game.

siblingPorts.title: Pinyon Shift
siblingPorts.notes: Playable preview of a static recompilation of Forza Horizon (Xbox 360) for PC, distributed as versioned releases. The port code is public (BSD-3-Clause), but the game itself is proprietary: you must supply your own Xbox 360 copy, and the repository ships no game content. Several similarly named forks exist; this is the original repository.

title: Descent II
description: Descent II is a 1996 first-person shooter game developed by Parallax Software and first published for MS-DOS by Interplay Productions. A version for the PlayStation was released under the title Descent Maximum. It is the second installment in the Descent video game series and the sequel to Descent.
notes: Source port of Descent II (MS-DOS) for Android, with touch controls, add-on mission packs and optional redbook music support. It needs the player's own copy of the game files.

siblingPorts.title: Descent 2 Mobile
siblingPorts.notes: Descent II (Interplay Entertainment, 1996) for Android (source port). Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Descent
description: Descent 3 is a first-person shooter video game developed by Outrage Entertainment and published by Interplay Entertainment. It was originally released for Microsoft Windows in North America on June 17, 1999. Descent 3 is the third game in the Descent video game series and a sequel to Descent II. The game takes place in a science fiction setting of the Solar System where the player is cast as Material Defender, a mercenary who must help an organization known as the Red Acropolis Research Team to stop robots infected by an alien virus.
notes: Source port of Descent (MS-DOS) for Android, forked from Descent Mobile, with on-screen touch controls, gyro support and add-on mission packs. It needs the player's own copy of the game files.

siblingPorts.title: Descent Mobile
siblingPorts.notes: Descent (Interplay Entertainment, 1995) for Android (source port). Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Diablo
description: Diablo is an action role-playing dungeon crawler video game series originally developed by Blizzard North and continued by Blizzard Entertainment after the original North studio shut down in 2005. The franchise is made up of the four main games: Diablo, Diablo II, Diablo III, and Diablo IV.
notes: Reverse-engineered engine for Diablo and the Hellfire expansion, rebuilt for modern systems. Requires the original Diablo 1 and Hellfire data files.

siblingPorts.title: DevilutionX
siblingPorts.notes: Diablo and Hellfire for modern systems (PC, consoles, handhelds), based on the reverse-engineered Devilution source.

title: The Dishwasher: Dead Samurai
description: The Dishwasher: Dead Samurai is a beat 'em up game developed by independent software developer James Silva for the Xbox 360's Xbox Live Arcade service. A Windows port was announced, but a release date on Steam has not yet been set.
notes: Community Android port of The Dishwasher: Dead Samurai (Xbox 360). It needs the original game.

title: Donkey Kong 64
description: Donkey Kong 64 is a 1999 platform game developed by Rare and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. It is the first Donkey Kong game to feature 3D gameplay. As the gorilla Donkey Kong, the player explores themed levels to collect items and rescue his family members from the crocodile King K. Rool. The player completes minigames and puzzles as five playable Kong characters—each with their own special abilities—to receive bananas and other collectibles. In multiplayer modes, up to four players can compete in deathmatch and last man standing games.
notes: Android port (NDK) of Donkey Kong 64: Recompiled, with RT64/Vulkan, N64ModernRuntime and SDL2. Bring your own NTSC-U 1.0 ROM. Latest release: v1.0.3-android-r7.

title: Doom 3 BFG Edition
description: Doom 3 is a 2004 first-person shooter survival horror game developed by id Software and published by Activision. It was originally released for Windows on August 3, 2004, before being adapted for Linux later that year, and ported by Aspyr Media for Mac OS X in 2005. Vicarious Visions ported the game to the Xbox, releasing it worldwide on April 4, 2005.
notes: Doom 3 BFG Edition (id Software, 2012) for Android (source port). Latest release: 3.5.0. Needs your own copy of the game (base folder).

title: Doom 64 Remastered
description: Doom 64 Remastered is a shooter game published by id Software, released in 2020.
notes: Doom 64 Remastered (id Software, 2020) for Android (source port). Latest release: 3.5.0. Needs your own copy of the game (DOOM64.WAD, DOOMSND.DLS, Doom64.kpf).

title: Doom
description: Doom is a 1993 first-person shooter game developed and published by id Software for MS-DOS. It is the first installment in the Doom franchise. The player assumes the role of a space marine, later unofficially referred to as Doomguy, fighting through hordes of undead humans and invading demons. The game begins on the moons of Mars and finishes in hell, with the player traversing each level to find its exit or defeat its final boss. It is an early example of 3D graphics in video games, and has enemies and objects as 2D images, a technique sometimes referred to as 2.5D graphics.
notes: Doom (id Software, 1993) for Android (source port). Latest release: 3.5.0. Needs your own copy of the game (DOOM.WAD).

siblingPorts.title: GZDoom
siblingPorts.notes: Feature-centric source port for all Doom-engine games, with an official Android build. Requires an IWAD (the freedoom project provides assets).

title: Doom II
description: Doom II, also known as Doom II: Hell on Earth, is a 1994 first-person shooter video game developed and published by id Software for MS-DOS. It was released on Mac OS the following year. Whereas the original Doom was initially only available through shareware and mail order, Doom II was the first Doom game released initially in stores.
notes: Doom II (id Software, 1994) for Android (source port). Latest release: 3.5.0. Needs your own copy of the game (DOOM2.WAD).

title: Doom (Playstation)
description: Doom (Playstation) is a shooter game published by id Software, released in 1995.
notes: Doom (Playstation) (id Software, 1995) for Android (source port). Latest release: 3.5.0. Needs your own copy of the game (.bin and .cue files).

title: Doraemon 3: Nobita no Machi SOS!
description: Doraemon 3: Nobita no Machi SOS! is a action-adventure game published by Epoch, released in 2000.
notes: Doraemon 3: Nobita no Machi SOS! (Epoch, 2000) for Android (source port). Latest release: v1.0.0. Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Cave Story
description: Cave Story is a 2004 Metroidvania game developed by Daisuke "Pixel" Amaya. It was released on December 20, 2004 for Microsoft Windows. The game revolves around Quote, a robot who wakes up suffering from amnesia and explores in diverse cavernous areas in order to uncover his backstory and escape from the cave. The character gains access to new areas as he powers up his weapons by collecting triangular experience crystals and solves various platforming puzzles. Quote speaks to non-player characters scattered around the game world in order to learn more about the world and its inhabitants.
notes: Unofficial open source port of Cave Story. The original freeware game data is required and is not distributed with the repository.

title: Dragon Ball: Raging Blast 2
description: Dragon Ball: Raging Blast 2 is a video game based on the manga and anime franchise Dragon Ball and is a follow-up to the 2009 video game Dragon Ball: Raging Blast. It was developed by Spike and published by Namco Bandai under the Bandai label for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 gaming consoles in the beginning of November 2010.
notes: Android (arm64) port of RB2 Recompiled: Dragon Ball: Raging Blast 2 recompiled with the ReXGlue SDK, packaged as an Android APK. No game data included; you need your own legally dumped copy. Latest release: v1.2.3 (APK).

title: Dragon Ball Z: Super Saiya Densetsu
game: Dragon Ball Z: Super Saiya Densetsu
description: Dragon Ball Z: Super Saiya Densetsu is a role-playing game published by Bandai in 1992.
project: Dragon Ball Z: Super Saiya Densetsu SNES Decomp
notes: Dragon Ball Z: Super Saiya Densetsu (Bandai, 1992) for Android (decompilation). Needs your own copy of the game.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
game: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
description: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess is a 2006 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the GameCube and Wii. Originally planned for release exclusively on the GameCube in November 2005, Nintendo delayed the release to refine the game, add more content and port it to the Wii. The Wii version was a launch game in North America in November 2006 and in Japan, Europe and Australia the following month. The GameCube version was released in December 2006 as the final first-party game for the console.
notes: From-scratch reimplementation of The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess that reads the game's assets from a legally dumped copy of the game disc. Ships official builds for every catalog platform, with the Android build compiled for ARM64; some platforms are supported on a best-effort basis.

siblingPorts.title: Dusklight
siblingPorts.notes: PC/mobile port of Twilight Princess built on the zeldaret/tp decompilation, with fixes and enhancements.

siblingPorts.title: Twilight Princess (Dusklight Dual Screen)
siblingPorts.notes: Android fork of Dusklight (Twilight Princess) with a second-screen layout for dual-screen handhelds such as the AYN Thor. Requires your own game files.

title: Digimon World 3
description: Digimon World 3 , also known as Digimon World 2003 in Europe and Australia, is a role-playing video game for the PlayStation developed by BEC and Boom Corp, and published by Bandai. It is the third installment in the Digimon World series and it was first released in June 2002 in North America and then in July 2002 in Japan and November 2002 in Europe. The game tells the story of Junior, who begins playing an MMORPG called "Digimon Online" with his friends, but when terrorists attack, Junior and the other players are trapped within the game and must find a way out using his Digimon partners.
notes: Digimon World 3 (Bandai, 2002) for Android (source port). Latest release: v1.4.0. Needs your own copy of the game.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom
game: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom
description: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom is a 2024 action-adventure game developed by Nintendo and Grezzo and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch. It is the first mainline The Legend of Zelda game with Princess Zelda as the main playable character.
notes: Alpha static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom (Switch) for Android and PC. No game files included; bring your own copy.

title: Elfen Lied Fighting
description: Elfen Lied Fighting is a fighting game published by Fan-made for Windows, released in 2025.
notes: Unofficial native Android port of the fan-made Elfen Lied Fighting PC game: offline play, touch controls and Japanese, English and Russian languages. Android 10+. Latest tag: v1.0.0-rc1.

title: Endless Sky
description: Endless Sky is a space trading and combat simulation video game, created by Michael Zahniser and first released in June 2015. In Endless Sky, the player starts out as a spaceship captain and can trade, transport passengers or fight pirates to earn money. There are also a few story lines that the player can choose to participate in. The game is similar to games in the Escape Velocity series.
notes: Endless Mobile: fork of the open-source game Endless Sky that adds Android support plus touchscreen and interface changes. Distributed through F-Droid as com.github.thewierdnut.endless_mobile; CI also publishes debug APKs. The game itself is free software, so no commercial copy is required.

title: Eternal Sonata
description: Eternal Sonata is a role-playing video game developed by tri-Crescendo and published by Bandai Namco Games. The game was originally released on Xbox 360 in 2007, followed by an expanded version releasing on PlayStation 3 the following year.
notes: Static recompilation of Eternal Sonata (Xbox 360) with ReXGlue. It converts the PPC executable to native x86_64 and wraps it in a small host runtime with overlays and hooks for mods; builds for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android.

title: Ultima VII
description: Ultima VIII: Pagan is a role-playing video game, released as the eighth part of the Ultima series. Released in 1994, it is a DOS-only title and is also the first game in the series to be rated M in North America. It was not as well-received as its predecessors, Ultima VII and Ultima VII Part Two: Serpent Isle.
notes: Open source engine for the Ultima VII and VIII games. Published GitHub releases are prereleases only, so no stable version is recorded.

title: F-Zero X
description: F-Zero X is a 1998 racing game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. It is the sequel to the original F-Zero (1990), and the first F-Zero game with 3D graphics. It has a steep learning curve and its gameplay experience is similar to that of the original. The F-Zero X Expansion Kit, an expansion pack for the 64DD featuring 12 more tracks and track and vehicle editors, was released in Japan in 2000.
notes: G-Diffuser is a native port of F-Zero X built on the inspectredc matching decompilation and the libultraship runtime. Version 1.2.2 ships Windows, Linux, macOS and Android builds and adds support for the Japan-only 64DD Expansion Kit, plus widescreen, an in-game enhancements menu, post-process shaders, mod packs, shareable tracks and machines, and ROM hack support. Requires your own F-Zero X ROM and, for the expansion content, your own 64DD disk dump. No game files are included.

title: Far Cry
description: Far Cry is an anthology franchise of first-person shooter games published by Ubisoft. The first game, Far Cry, was developed by Crytek to premiere their CryEngine software, and released in March 2004. Subsequently, Ubisoft obtained the rights to the franchise and the bulk of the development is handled by Ubisoft Montreal with assistance from other Ubisoft satellite studios. The following games in the series have used a Ubisoft-modified version of the CryEngine, the Dunia Engine, allowing for open world gameplay.
notes: Android and Linux port of Far Cry (CryEngine 1) via SDL3, based on NearChuckle and using Mesa Zink for OpenGL over Vulkan. Note: it relies on the leaked Far Cry source and needs the game itself.

title: Fear & Hunger
description: Fear & Hunger is a 2018 survival horror role-playing video game developed by Miro Haverinen and published by Happy Paintings. It was released on 11 December 2018 for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The game is set in an alternate history medieval dark fantasy setting and follows four characters, one of whom the player chooses as a playable protagonist. Their goal is to find a man named Le'garde inside the labyrinthine, deadly Dungeons of Fear and Hunger, where monsters and gods dwell.
notes: Android version of Fear & Hunger that runs the game without an emulator. It is a community port distributed as an app and needs a copy of the game.

title: Fear & Hunger 2: Termina
description: Fear & Hunger is a 2018 survival horror role-playing video game developed by Miro Haverinen and published by Happy Paintings. It was released on 11 December 2018 for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The game is set in an alternate history medieval dark fantasy setting and follows four characters, one of whom the player chooses as a playable protagonist. Their goal is to find a man named Le'garde inside the labyrinthine, deadly Dungeons of Fear and Hunger, where monsters and gods dwell.
notes: Ongoing community project to bring Fear & Hunger 2: Termina to Android. It runs the game without an emulator and needs your own copy.

title: Heroes of Might and Magic II
game: Heroes of Might and Magic II
description: Heroes of Might and Magic II is a turn-based strategy game developed and published by New World Computing in 1996. Players build armies, develop towns and defeat rival heroes across fantasy maps.
notes: Engine reimplementation for Heroes of Might and Magic II, written from scratch in C++. Ships official Android builds on Google Play plus Windows, macOS and Linux releases.

title: Final Doom (Playstation)
description: Final Doom is a 1996 first-person shooter game developed by TeamTNT and published by id Software for MS-DOS and Macintosh computers, as well as for the PlayStation, although the latter featured a selection of levels from the game and from Master Levels for Doom II.
notes: Final Doom (Playstation) (id Software, 1996) for Android (source port). Latest release: 3.5.0. Needs your own copy of the game (.bin and .cue files).

title: Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones
description: Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones is a tactical role-playing game developed by Intelligent Systems, and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Advance handheld video game console in 2004 for Japan and 2005 in the West. It is the eighth entry in the Fire Emblem series, the second to be released outside Japan, and the third and final title to be developed for the Game Boy Advance after The Binding Blade and its prequel The Blazing Blade.
notes: Playable Windows and Android ARM64 static recompilation of Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones (Game Boy Advance, 2004). Still early, but playable. Latest release: v0.1.20.

title: Forza Horizon 2
description: Forza Horizon 2 is a 2014 racing video game developed for Microsoft's Xbox One and Xbox 360 consoles. It is the sequel to 2012's Forza Horizon, the seventh instalment in the Forza series, and the series' first multi-console instalment. The Xbox One version of the game was developed by Playground Games, the team behind the original Forza Horizon, while Sumo Digital developed the version for Xbox 360, with Forza series developer Turn 10 Studios supporting both builds. The Xbox 360 version is also the final Forza game released for the platform.
notes: Unofficial static recompilation of Forza Horizon 2 (Xbox 360, 2014) for Android and Linux. It ships no game files and does nothing without files extracted from your own legally obtained copy. Non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with Microsoft/Xbox Game Studios/Playground Games/Turn 10.

title: The Settlers
description: The Settlers is a real-time strategy and city-building game developed and published by Blue Byte in 1993. Players expand a medieval settlement by managing resources, roads and military outposts.
notes: Freeserf.net is an open-source Settlers 1 clone written in C#. It requires the original game data and supports local network multiplayer.

title: Freespace 2
description: FreeSpace 2 is a 1999 space combat simulation video game developed by Volition as the sequel to Descent: FreeSpace – The Great War. It was completed ahead of schedule in less than a year, and released to very positive reviews, but the game became a commercial failure, and was described by certain critics as one of 1999's most unfairly overlooked titles.
notes: Freespace 2 (Interplay Entertainment, 1999) for Android (source port). Needs your own copy of the game.

title: FTL: Faster Than Light
description: FTL: Faster Than Light is a roguelike game created by indie developer Subset Games, which was released for Windows, MacOS, and Linux in September 2012. In the game, the player controls the crew of a single spacecraft, holding critical information to be delivered to an allied fleet, while being pursued by a large rebel fleet. The player must guide the spacecraft through eight sectors, each with planetary systems and events procedurally generated in a roguelike fashion, while facing rebel and other hostile forces, recruiting new crew, and outfitting and upgrading their ship.
notes: Native Android port of Project Wormhole, the open-source FTL engine implementation. It runs FTL: Faster Than Light on Android using your own game files.

title: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance
description: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance is a 2003 tactical role-playing game developed by Square for the Game Boy Advance, and published by Square in Japan and Nintendo internationally. A successor to Final Fantasy Tactics (1997), the story follows the trials of some children from the town of St. Ivalice after a magical book transforms their home into a fantasy realm of the same name. Gameplay has player teams fighting in turn-based combat on a grid, with units using a themed Job system. A new feature is a "Law" system, which places random limitations on player action during battles.
notes: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance (Square, 2003) for Android (static recompilation). Latest release: v1.6. Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Galaxy on Fire 2™ Full HD
description: A hyperdrive malfunction sends Keith T. Maxwell tumbling through space and time to fight for his life against a mysterious alien armada that is wreaking havoc.
notes: Galaxy on Fire 2™ Full HD (Fishlabs, 2009) for Android (source port). Latest release: 2026.10.18. Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Garry's Mod
description: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.
notes: Garry's Mod (Facepunch Studios, 2006) for Android (source port). Latest release: 0.1.29. Needs your own copy of the game.

title: Pokémon Red
description: Pokémon Red Version and Pokémon Blue Version are 1996 role-playing video games (RPGs) developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy. They are the first installments of the Pokémon video game series and were first released in Japan as Pocket Monsters Red and Pocket Monsters Green, followed by the special edition Pocket Monsters Blue later that year.
notes: Native Lua/LÖVE2D recreation of the first-generation Pokémon games, also covering later generations. It builds for desktop and mobile and uses your own game data.

title: Pokémon Gold
description: Pokémon Gold Version and Pokémon Silver Version are 1999 role-playing video games developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Color. They are the first installments in the second generation of the Pokémon video game series. They were released in Japan on November 21st, 1999, Australia and North America on October 15th, 2000, and Europe on April 6th, 2001.
notes: Recompilation project for the second-generation Pokémon games, forked from Gen1Recomp. It runs on desktop and Android with your own game data.

title: Super Mario 64
description: Super Mario 64 is a 1996 platform game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. It is the first Super Mario game to feature 3D graphics, combining traditional Super Mario gameplay, visual style, and characters in a large open world. In the game, Bowser invades Princess Peach's castle, kidnaps her, and hides the castle's Power Stars in different worlds inside magical paintings. As Mario, the player traverses levels and collects Power Stars to unlock areas of the castle, reach Bowser and rescue Peach.

siblingPorts.title: Ghostship
siblingPorts.notes: Native port of Super Mario 64 from the decompilation, by the HarbourMasters team. Uses the game's data from your own legally obtained ROM. Multiplatform, including Android, iOS and Switch.

siblingPorts.notes: Super Mario 64 (Nintendo, 1996) for Android (source port). Latest release: 1.0.1. Needs your own copy of the game (Ghostship folder).
